notes: All-variant static metrics use the first seed-0 grasp/base candidate and 11 interpolated limb configurations.
Joint-space inertia trace is a pose-specific comparison, not a scalar inertia for the whole limb.
Arm, normal leg, and light leg exploratory MPC probes used 16 candidates and at most 100 control iterations; light leg masses and inertias were scaled together after choosing the same base/grasp.
Full leg probe used 64 candidates, at most 200 control iterations, and reproduced the original replay error.
Probe replay continues through all recorded corrections to measure divergence; it is a diagnostic, not execution of an accepted plan.
Short scratch tests compare fixed correction sequences with and without intervening discarded candidate rollouts; Bullet save/restore did not eliminate the measured discrepancy.
